versions.subject: rule: suspicious programs - no DLL in command line
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
filter1:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
filter2:
    ParentImage|contains: 
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Microsoft\Edge\'
condition: selection and not filter1 and not filter2
